whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: A Truly International and Inclusive Community
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Join a vibrant student body representing over 40 nationalities. At UST, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture of belonging that honors and reflects the full diversity of our community across cultures, languages, identities, learning styles, and experiences. Diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s embedded in the way we learn, interact, and grow together.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Close-Knit, Family-Oriented Atmosphere
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Our strong sense of community ensures every child is known, supported, and valued. Parents, students, and teachers work together to create a welcoming and nurturing environment.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Inquiry-Driven, Whole-Child Education
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Our holistic, inquiry-based curriculum is tailored to support students’ academic growth while nurturing creativity, curiosity, and emotional well-being. Learning at UST is student-centered, meaningful, and joyful.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Hands-On, Real-World Learning
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: From field trips and outdoor education to project-based activities and school-wide events, students engage in experiential learning that deepens understanding and builds real-life skills.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Character and Values at the Core
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: UST promotes empathy, kindness, and integrity through weekly Guidance classes, community service programs, and student-led charitable initiatives. We help students grow into thoughtful, responsible global citizens.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Personalized Learning in Small Classes
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: With small class sizes and a commitment to differentiated instruction, our teachers can meet each student where they are and help them thrive.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Japanese Language for All Levels
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Daily Japanese instruction is ability-based, allowing both native speakers and beginners to advance confidently in a structured and supportive setting.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Inclusive and Active Student Life
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Our robust physical education program includes weekly swimming lessons and a wide range of sports and activities that promote fitness, teamwork, and confidence.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Academic Support Built Into Every Day
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Daily ESL, learning support, and tutoring services are integrated into the school day, ensuring all students have the tools they need to succeed.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Enriching After-School Programs
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: From arts and STEM to leadership clubs and sports, students can explore their interests through a wide variety of extracurricular activities. Daily extended care is also available for busy families.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Accessible, Values-Driven Education
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: We believe great education should be within reach. UST is committed to keeping tuition reasonable while upholding a high standard of learning. We take pride in offering a mission-aligned, values-based education that supports a wide range of families.

whyChooseUstFeatures.heading: Convenience for Families
whyChooseUstFeatures.description: Located in central Shibuya, UST offers easy access to public transport and excellent facilities. Our school bus service and healthy organic lunch program provide added convenience for working parents.
